protocol: Compute Morgan radius-2/2048-bit nearest-training support under each existing random fold and full-training support for blind test. Post-stratify random-fold OOF rows to the blind-test support histogram, fold-rank each standalone model, and evaluate weighted AUROC, AP and fixed-call target-prior MCC. This is a covariate-shift diagnostic using no test labels and no model blending. The deployed UMAP mean-block is shown only as a cross-split reference because it was not refit on random folds.
